_labeling: Legitimate least-privilege footprint. Config is persisted in a JSON file (/tmp/mcpguard_env_config.json), hard-coded as a default and never exposed as a tool parameter. Despite the server name, the tools do not read process environment variables; they read/write the config file.

get_config.notes: Loads (reads) the config file to look up a key.

set_config.notes: Loads then rewrites the config file.
